description: This file provides inline implementations of string utility functions for Windows, supporting pre-MSVC8 environments. It includes safe string copy and conversion functions, and handles differences in MSVC versions.

classes.name: WindowsStringUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility functions for safe string operations and conversions on Windows.

methods.name: safe_wcscpy
methods.description: Safely copies a wide string to a destination buffer, ensuring null-termination, compatible with older MSVC versions.

methods.name: safe_wcsncpy
methods.description: Safely copies a specified number of characters from a wide string to a destination buffer, ensuring null-termination.

methods.name: safe_mbstowcs
methods.description: Converts a multibyte string to a wide string safely, using MSVC8 or older methods.

methods.name: safe_wcstombs
methods.description: Converts a wide string to a multibyte string safely.

methods.name: GetBaseName
methods.description: Returns the filename component of a path, stripping directory information.
